name: s81sl_vp-s81sl_vp-COMMIT
purpose: S81-SLICE deliverable 3: beat-leaf sub-leaf to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit). 10-18 S81-SLICE vp NORMR (op 7: hc_pre from the G-unit's leaf row R) + POST row order = the G-unit's (post R+1, comb R+2..R+5).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81sl_vp u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -DOT_S81SL_VP_HARD --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/slice/ot_s81sl_vp.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81sl_vp/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81sl_vp/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81sl_vp --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81sl_vp --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_512x128_m4_r2c2 --macro-view physical/ref_tile/s81sl_hcpl/views/ot_dsrom_su_hcpost_lane_pr > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-SLICE (stream 0cm): beat-leaf store + hc_post sub-leaf of the DV slice: command sequencer, 2 x 512x128 leaf-store banks, 16 hard s81sl_hcpl lanes (closed lane_pr re-kit). 10-18: vp op 7 NORMR (hc_pre = leaf row a0, one-step sequencer read) + POST coefficient rows in the G-unit's order (post a0, comb a0+1..a0+4).
